rv.q: Their commitment to the production and our wider wellbeing, deserves considerable praise even if the show itself could benefit from a less didactic approach and an overhaul of the lyrics.
I'm giving this 3 stars. It is heartfelt and sentimental, but needs a bit of focus.

cn.t: This ambitious musical interweaving Alexander Fleming's penicillin discovery with a modern antibiotic-resistant superbug story receives a mixed reception, praised for its intriguing concept but falling short in execution.
